name: Ridge Outdoor International Limited
summary: Ridge Outdoor International Limited engages in the design and manufacturing of fishing-related equipment and fishing tackle equipment. The company's products include chairs, bedchairs and other accessories, such as fishing chairs, fishing bedchairs, rod pods, barrows and seatboxes; shoulder bags, fishing backpacks and rod holdalls; and tents, such as bivvies, social bivvies and shelters, as well as brollies and landing nets. Its products serve a wide range of fishing scenarios such as carp fishing, match fishing, lure fishing, fly fishing and ice fishing.
